policy: No technique excluded in advance. Compare meaning, useful immersion depth, latency,devicecost,privacy and annual economics. Prior completed experiments retained; no new research claim for old work.

methods.conclusion: Fast reviewed local word flips remain useful for beginners. Uncontextualized word MT confuses role/sense; agreement of dictionary alternatives is not semantic proof.
Indexed lexicalized phrases, complete utterances and explicit context masks. Bulk mine preserves alternatives; exact whole-sentence recurrence remains low.
Apertium morphology/tagging/transfer and bounded source constructions can reuse grammar. Same-POS senses and idioms still need lexical/context selection.
A word appearing in full target is a useful clue, not proof that this source occurrence can be replaced. Retained200-message target-informed extension increased material errors.
Larger snippets preserve some context but can still include missing/imported constituents or change sense; exact reverse equality over-withholds.
Whole sentences avoid many isolated-role problems and support correct-grammar full flips. Source typo/negation scope still produced material errors. Not all pairs or phones qualified.
Local reverse plus English sentenceembedding helps reject observed errors, but high abstention and per-pair calibration remain. Not a confidence probability.

MetricX24 can score source+target without reverse; commercial license feasible,2.46GB bf16 weights before runtime, no local accuracy/latency qualification. COMETKiwi22 weights have noncommercial license.
ES/JA/SW six-source pilot complete; both reviews find oneSwahili meaning change.4.90GB peakCPU and7–26s cases are notphone qualification. Noactivation.
DeepSeek/OpenAI prices compared. Structured contextual spans are a separate accuracy/output-token arm from full-sentence translation; no provider quality or token-usage claim.

methods.status: Candidate selected for next comparative UI evaluation
methods.conclusion: Immediate accepted word/phrase flips; asynchronous whole-sentence target. Quality-check full target separately from fragment alignment. An unsafe fragment cannot be licensed by a good sentence score.
Use public/licensed material to expand reviewed mappings offline. Cache exact context locally; do not infer generalized rules or upload private chats from mere repetition.
